jobs.title: Facility Manager (80-100%)
jobs.description:
In der Rolle als Facility Manager verantwortest du den Betrieb, Unterhalt und die Kontrolle der technischen Gebäudeinfrastruktur mit Schwerpunkt auf Elektro-, Sicherheits- und Schwachstromanlagen und stellst dabei die Verfügbarkeit sowie die Betriebssicherheit am Standort Hinwil sicher. Interessiert? Dann bewirb dich jetzt!

Was wirst du tun

• Betreuung, Betrieb und Kontrolle von Elektroanlagen inkl. Primärversorgung, Hauptverteilungen sowie Innen- und Aussenbeleuchtung, Notlichtanlagen, Blitzschutz- und Erdungssysteme

• Betrieb und Unterhalt von Schwachstromanlagen sowie Netzwerk- und IT-Infrastruktur

• Betreuung und Kontrolle von Sicherheitsanlagen (Brandmeldeanlage, Zutrittskontrolle, Videoüberwachung, CO₂-Löschanlagen) sowie Feuerlöschern, Brandabschottungen, Nasslöschposten und elektrisch betriebenen Brandschutztüren und Toren

• Betreuung automatischer Türen und weiterer technischer Gebäudesysteme sowie Sicherstellung der Funktion und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Gebäudetechnik

• Organisation und Koordination von Wartungen, Revisionen und technischen Kontrollen mit externen Dienstleistern

• Unterstützung bei Reparaturen, Erweiterungen, technischen Anpassungen sowie Bereitstellung von Sitzungszimmern und Räumen für Anlässe

• Reaktion auf Alarmmeldungen sowie selbstständige Initialisierung und Leitung kleiner Gebäudeprojekte

•
 Unterstützung des Teamleiters Facility Management Unterhalt, des Facility Managers Projekte sowie des Abteilungsleiters Facility Management bei Mittel- und Grossprojekten

Wer du bist

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektroinstallateur:in/Montage-Elektriker:in oder vergleichbares

• Handwerkliche Berufserfahrung mit ersten Kontakten zum industriellen Facility Management wünschenswert

• Gute körperliche Verfassung

• Bereitschaft zu gelegentlich unregelmässigen Arbeitszeiten

• Dienstleistungsorientierte Persönlichkeit mit Fähigkeit und Freude im Umgang mit Menschen

• Teamorientierte Arbeitsweise und Zuverlässigkeit

• Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil

Wer wir sind

Bei Belimo sind wir stolz darauf, unser Unternehmen zu einem lohnenden Arbeitsplatz zu machen. Unsere Führungskräfte sind werteorientiert und fördern neue Ideen in ihren Teams auf der ganzen Welt. Durch unsere Leidenschaft schaffen unsere Mitarbeiter nicht nur erstaunliche Produkte, sondern revolutionieren auch die HLK-Branche. Die Investition in unsere Mitarbeitenden ist das Herzstück von Belimo, wenn es darum geht, verschiedene kreative Talente zu engagieren, um ein branchenführendes Unternehmen aufzubauen. Der Erfolg unserer Unternehmensmarke basiert auf der Kompetenz und dem Engagement jedes Einzelnen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Nel ruolo di Facility Manager, sei responsabile per il funzionamento, la manutenzione e il controllo dell'infrastruttura di costruzione tecnica con un focus sui sistemi elettrici, di sicurezza e di bassa potenza, garantendo disponibilità e sicurezza operativa presso il sito Hinwil. Interessante? Quindi applicare ora!

Cosa farai

• Supporto, funzionamento e controllo dei sistemi elettrici incl. Fornitura primaria, distribuzione principale e illuminazione interna ed esterna, illuminazione di emergenza, protezione dei fulmini e sistemi di terra

• Funzionamento e manutenzione di impianti di alimentazione off-peak e infrastrutture di rete e IT

• Supporto e controllo dei sistemi di sicurezza (sistema di allarme antincendio, controllo accessi, videosorveglianza, sistemi di estinzione di CO2, estintori, barriere antincendio, stazioni di estinzione e porte e cancelli elettrici

• Supporto per porte automatiche e altri sistemi di costruzione tecnica, oltre a garantire la funzione e il miglioramento continuo della tecnologia costruttiva

• Organizzazione e coordinamento di manutenzione, audit e controlli tecnici con i fornitori di servizi esterni

• Supporto per riparazioni, estensioni, modifiche tecniche e fornitura di sale riunioni e sale per eventi

• Risposta ad allarmi e inizializzazione indipendente e gestione di piccoli progetti di costruzione

•
Supporto per il team leader Facility Management Maintenance, i progetti Facility Manager e la capo reparto Facility Management per progetti di medie e grandi dimensioni

Chi sei

• Allenamento completo come installatore elettrico:in/assembly elettricista:in o equivalente

• Esperienza professionale con primi contatti alla gestione di impianti industriali auspicabile

• Buone condizioni fisiche

• Volontà di lavorare ore occasionali irregolari

• Personalità orientata al servizio con capacità e piacere nel trattare con le persone

• Metodi di lavoro orientati al team e affidabilità

• Conoscenza fluente del tedesco, l'inglese è vantaggioso

Chi siamo

A Belimo, siamo orgogliosi di rendere la nostra azienda un luogo gratificante per lavorare. I nostri leader sono orientati al valore e promuovono nuove idee nelle loro squadre in tutto il mondo. Attraverso la nostra passione, i nostri dipendenti non solo creano prodotti sorprendenti, ma anche rivoluzionano l'industria HVAC. Investire nei nostri dipendenti è al centro di Belimo quando si tratta di coinvolgere diversi talenti creativi per costruire una società leader del settore. Il successo del nostro marchio aziendale si basa sulla competenza e l'impegno di ogni individuo.
descriptionByLocale.en:
In the role of Facility Manager, you are responsible for the operation, maintenance and control of the technical building infrastructure with a focus on electrical, safety and low-power systems, ensuring availability and operational safety at the Hinwil site. Interested? Then apply now!

What will you do

• Support, operation and control of electrical systems incl. Primary supply, main distribution and indoor and outdoor lighting, emergency lighting, lightning protection and earthing systems

• Operation and maintenance of off-peak power plants as well as network and IT infrastructure

• Support and control of security systems (fire alarm system, access control, video surveillance, CO2 extinguishing systems), fire extinguishers, fire barriers, wet extinguishing stations and electrically operated fire doors and gates

• Support for automatic doors and other technical building systems as well as ensuring the function and continuous improvement of building technology

• Organisation and coordination of maintenance, audits and technical controls with external service providers

• Support for repairs, extensions, technical adjustments and provision of meeting rooms and rooms for events

• Response to alarms and independent initialization and management of small building projects

•
Support for the team leader Facility Management Maintenance, the Facility Manager Projects and the department head Facility Management for medium and large projects

Who you are

• Completed training as an electrical installer:in/assembly electrician:in or equivalent

• Professional experience with first contacts to industrial facility management desirable

• Good physical condition

• Willingness to work occasionally irregular hours

• Service-oriented personality with ability and pleasure in dealing with people

• Team-oriented working methods and reliability

• Flowing knowledge of German, English is advantageous

Who we are

At Belimo, we are proud to make our company a rewarding place to work. Our leaders are value-driven and promote new ideas in their teams around the world. Through our passion, our employees not only create amazing products, but also revolutionize the HVAC industry. Investing in our employees is at the heart of Belimo when it comes to engaging diverse creative talents to build an industry-leading company. The success of our corporate brand is based on the competence and commitment of each individual.

Chi sei

• Formazione o ulteriore formazione nel settore della gestione della supply chain, del commercio internazionale o di una specializzazione comparabile.

• Diversi anni di esperienza professionale (di solito almeno 5 anni) in un ambiente logistico internazionale, commerciale o industriale.

• Conoscenza approfondita delle normative nazionali e internazionali nei settori delle dogane, del controllo delle esportazioni e delle sanzioni.

• Alta affinità IT e conoscenze utente molto buone in Microsoft Office e SAP; La conoscenza di SAP GTS è un vantaggio.

• Il pensiero imprenditoriale, l'iniziativa e la volontà di assumersi la responsabilità e promuovere attivamente le questioni di conformità.

• Giudizio forte, forza analitica e un modo di lavoro strutturato, attento e orientato alla soluzione.

• Capacità di gestire più priorità allo stesso tempo e anche tenere traccia di loro in un ambiente dinamico.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you excited about international trade flows, complex regulations and global supply chains? Then use your expertise to actively shape our trade compliance processes and make a decisive contribution to the safe and successful business operations of our company.

What will you do

• monitoring transaction-related trading activities and taking appropriate measures in the event of identified risks or irregularities.

• Establish, revise and continuously update policies and work instructions in the areas of customs, origin and export control.

• Advising and supporting internal stakeholders on issues related to global trade and customs processes.

• Ensure the correct classification of all imported and exported products, software and technologies in accordance with national and international regulations.

• Contact point for authorities and external bodies such as customs, SECO and IHK.

• Implementation of operational activities related to origin calculations in SAP GTS and Intrastat messages.

• Ensure statutory retention periods by the various divisions of the company.

• Report potential export violations or sensitive compliance issues to the Global Trade Compliance Manager.

• Close cooperation with relevant departments to ensure efficient use of SAP GTS compliance and customs modules.

Who you are

• Training or further education in the field of supply chain management, international trade or a comparable specialisation.

• Several years of professional experience (ideally at least 5 years) in an international logistics, trade or industrial environment.

• In-depth knowledge of national and international regulations in the areas of customs, export control and sanctions.

• High IT affinity and very good user knowledge in Microsoft Office and SAP; Knowledge of SAP GTS is an advantage.

• Entrepreneurial thinking, initiative and the willingness to take responsibility and actively promote compliance issues.

• Strong judgment, analytical strength and a structured, careful and solution-oriented way of working.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities at the same time and also keep track of them in a dynamic environment.

• Communication-strong, team-oriented and flexible personality with reliable knowledge of German and English.

Who we are

At Belimo, we are proud to make our company a rewarding place to work. Our leaders are value-driven and promote new ideas in their teams around the world. Through our passion, our employees not only create amazing products, but also revolutionize the HVAC industry. Investing in our employees is at the heart of Belimo when it comes to engaging diverse creative talents to build an industry-leading company. The success of our corporate brand is based on the competence and commitment of each individual.

• Komplexe Projekte und Multi-Workstream-Vorhaben planen, steuern und überwachen – inklusive Scope, Zeitplan, Budget, Ressourcen, Risiken und Deliverables

• Bereichsübergreifende Abhängigkeiten koordinieren und eine reibungslose Zusammenarbeit zwischen Engineering, Produktion, Qualität und weiteren Bereichen sicherstellen

• Einhaltung von Governance, Prozessen, Methoden und Deliverables sicherstellen sowie Projektleiter und Teammitglieder proaktiv coachen

• Vollständige, qualitativ hochwertige Projektdaten pflegen und transparent über Status, Bereitschaft, Lücken und erforderliche Massnahmen berichten

• Risiko-, Problem- und Änderungsmanagement verantworten – von der Identifikation und Bewertung über Massnahmen bis hin zu Freigaben und Eskalationen

• Faktenbasierte Entscheidungen vorbereiten durch Konsolidierung von Status, Risiken und Fortschritt sowie klare Entscheidungsunterlagen und Empfehlungen für die Führungsebene

• Strukturierte Stakeholder-Kommunikation, Abstimmung und Konfliktlösung über Abteilungen und Projekte hinweg sicherstellen

• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Projektdurchführung, Methoden, Tools und Zusammenarbeit durch Lessons Learned und Feedback vorantreiben

Wer du bist

• Technischer Abschluss (z. B. Maschinenbau oder Elektrotechnik) auf FH/ETH/Universitätsniveau mit breitem Wissen in angrenzenden technischen Disziplinen (T-Profil)

• Mindestens 6 Jahre Erfahrung in der Leitung interdisziplinärer Entwicklungsprojekte mit industriellen mechatronischen Geräten

• Fundierte Methodenkenntnisse im Projektmanagement; eine PM-Zertifizierung ist ein Plus

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in PM-Tools (z. B. Jira, Sciforma, Planview) sowie in Planung, Steuerung und Reporting

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Koordination bereichsübergreifender Teams und enger Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklung (Elektronik, Mechanik, Software), Produktion, Qualität und weiteren Bereichen

You will ensure structured project implementation, clear governance and robust risk management, enable fact-based decision-making at management level and foster collaboration across all functions. You are a driving force for the continuous improvement of project work throughout the company.

What will you do

• Plan, control and monitor complex projects and multi-workstream projects – including scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks and deliverables

• Coordinate interdependencies and ensure smooth cooperation between engineering, production, quality and other areas

• Ensure compliance with governance, processes, methods and deliverables as well as proactively coach project managers and team members

• Maintain complete, high-quality project data and report transparently on status, readiness, gaps and required actions

• Responsible for risk, problem and change management – from identification and evaluation to measures and approvals and escalations

• Prepare fact-based decisions by consolidating status, risks and progress, as well as clear decision documents and recommendations for management

• Ensure structured stakeholder communication, coordination and conflict resolution across departments and projects

• Continuous improvement of project implementation, methods, tools and collaboration driven by lessons learned and feedback

Who you are

• Technical degree (e.g. mechanical engineering or electrical engineering) at FH/ETH/university level with broad knowledge in adjacent technical disciplines (T-profile)

• At least 6 years of experience in managing interdisciplinary development projects with industrial mechatronic devices

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager (80-100%)
jobs.description:
Summary

Lead complex, cross‑functional development projects for industrial mechatronic products from planning to successful delivery. In this role, you ensure structured execution, clear governance and robust risk management, while enabling fact‑based decisions for leadership and fostering strong collaboration across all functions. You’ll be a key driver of continuous improvement in how projects are run across the organization.

What You'll Do

• Plan, steer and monitor complex or multi‑workstream projects, including scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks and deliverables.

• Coordinate cross‑functional dependencies and ensure smooth collaboration between Engineering, Production, Quality and other domains.

• Ensure adherence to defined governance, processes, methods and deliverables, and proactively coach project leads and team members.

• Maintain complete, high‑quality project data (planning, costs, resources) and provide transparent reporting on status, readiness, gaps and required actions.

• Lead risk, issue and change management, including systematic identification, assessment, mitigation, approvals and escalation according to governance.

• Enable fact‑based decisions by consolidating status, risks and progress, and preparing clear decision papers, scenarios and recommendations for leadership.

• Drive structured stakeholder communication, alignment and conflict resolution across departments and multiple projects.

• Lead continuous improvement of project execution, methods, tools and collaboration through lessons learned and feedback.

Who You Are

• Technical degree in a relevant field (e.g. Mechanical or Electrical Engineering) at FH/ETH/University level, with broad knowledge in adjacent technical disciplines (T‑profile).

• Minimum 6 years of experience leading interdisciplinary development projects involving industrial mechatronic devices.

• Strong methodological expertise in project management; formal PM certification is a plus.

• High proficiency with project management tools, (e.g. Jira, Sciforma, Planview) and methods, including planning, controlling and reporting.

• Proven experience coordinating cross‑functional teams and working closely with Development (electronics, mechanics, software), Production, Quality and other business domains.

• Strong understanding of business and economic correlations, enabling sound trade‑off and impact assessments.

• Service‑oriented mindset with excellent communication skills; empathetic, solution‑oriented, proactive and able to motivate and inspire as a project leader.

• Very good command of English; advanced German highly desirable, combined with strong self‑organization, ownership mentality, holistic thinking and high resilience.

Who We Are

At Belimo, we take pride in making our company a rewarding place to work. Our leaders are value-driven and encourage new ideas in their teams around the world. Through our passion, our employees are not only creating amazing products, they are revolutionizing the HVAC industry. Investing in our people is at the heart of Belimo's approach to engaging diverse creative talent to grow an industry-leading company. The success of our corporate brand is based on the expertise and commitment of each individual.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sintesi

I progetti di sviluppo complessi e interfunzionali di prodotti meccatronici industriali, dalla pianificazione alla realizzazione di successo, sono al centro di un'esecuzione strutturata, di una chiara governance e di una solida gestione dei rischi, consentendo al tempo stesso di prendere decisioni di leadership basate sui fatti e di promuovere una forte collaborazione in tutte le funzioni.

Cosa farai?

- pianificare, guidare e monitorare progetti complessi o multifunzionali, compresi la portata, il calendario, il bilancio, le risorse, i rischi e i risultati. - coordinare le dipendenze interfunzionali e garantire una collaborazione regolare tra ingegneria, produzione, qualità e altri settori. - garantire l'adesione a una governance definita, processi, metodi e risultati e alleaggiare proattivamente i responsabili dei progetti e i membri del team. - mantenere dati completi e di alta qualità dei progetti (pianificazione, costi, risorse) e fornire relazioni trasparenti sullo stato, la disponibilità, le lacune e le azioni richieste.

- Gestione dei rischi, delle questioni e dei cambiamenti, compresa l'identificazione sistematica, la valutazione, la mitigazione, l'approvazione e l'escalation in base alla governance. - Abilitare decisioni basate sui fatti consolidando lo stato, i rischi e i progressi e preparando documenti di decisione chiari, scenari e raccomandazioni per la leadership. - Guidare la comunicazione strutturata delle parti interessate, l'allineamento e la risoluzione dei conflitti tra dipartimenti e più progetti. - Migliorare continuamente l'esecuzione dei progetti, metodi, strumenti e collaborazione attraverso le lezioni apprese e il feedback.

Chi sei

- Laurea in ingegneria meccanica o elettrica in FH/ETH/University, con ampia conoscenza in discipline tecniche adiacenti (profilo T). - Minimo 6 anni di esperienza per progetti di sviluppo interdisciplinari che coinvolgono dispositivi meccatronici industriali. - Forte competenza metodologica nella gestione dei progetti; certificazione PM formale è un plus. - Alta competenza con strumenti di gestione dei progetti, (ad esempio Jira, Sciforma, Planview) e metodi, tra cui pianificazione, controllo e reporting.

- esperienza professionale che coordina i team interfunzionali e lavora a stretto contatto con lo sviluppo (elettronica, meccanica, software), produzione, qualità e altri settori di attività. - comprensione approfondita delle correlazioni economiche ed economiche, che consente valutazioni di trade-off e di impatto. - mentalità orientata al servizio con eccellenti capacità di comunicazione; empatetica, orientata alla soluzione, proattiva e capace di trovare la base per il settore e ispirare un leader di progetto.

- Ottimo comando dell'inglese; tedesco avanzato altamente desiderabile, combinato con una forte auto-organizzazione, la mentalità proprietaria, il pensiero olistico e l'alta resilienza.

Chi siamo

A Belimo, siamo orgogliosi di rendere la nostra azienda un luogo di lavoro gratificante. I nostri leader sono guidati dal valore e incoraggiano nuove idee nei loro team di tutto il mondo. Attraverso la nostra passione, i nostri dipendenti non solo stanno creando prodotti sorprendenti, stanno rivoluzionando il settore HVAC. Investire nelle nostre persone è il cuore dell'approccio di Belimo per coinvolgere diversi talenti creativi per crescere un'azienda leader del settore. Il successo del nostro marchio aziendale è basato sulla competenza e l'impegno di ogni individuo.

Die Investition in unsere Mitarbeitenden ist das Herzstück von Belimo, wenn es darum geht, verschiedene kreative Talente zu engagieren, um ein branchenführendes Unternehmen aufzubauen. Der Erfolg unserer Unternehmensmarke basiert auf der Kompetenz und dem Engagement jedes Einzelnen.

Gardez nos zones opérationnelles en marche et assurez-vous que les temps d'arrêt ne deviennent pas un problème. Avec nous, vous prenez des responsabilités, conduisez des améliorations et apportez votre expertise là où elle a vraiment un impact.

Que ferez-vous ?

•
Correction rapide et professionnelle des défauts et des temps d'arrêt de l'usine pendant le travail posté

•
Surveillance des éléments de l'installation et action proactive conformément aux accords de niveau de service

•
Mise en œuvre et coordination des travaux d ' entretien prévus

•
Création et optimisation de plans de maintenance en coopération avec la planification de maintenance

•
Assurer des normes de qualité et des améliorations continues en identifiant les vulnérabilités

•
Assurer la sécurité, la disponibilité et la fiabilité des installations

•
Collaboration dans la mise en service, la conversion, l'entretien et les projets interdépartements

•
Soutien, formation et orientation professionnelle des employés

• Travail occasionnel en hauteur et donc application sûre de l'APSC

Heures de travail

• Heures de travail de base dans le modèle de poste entre 6 heures et 23 heures en 2 postes

• Préparation aux missions spéciales occasionnelles (par exemple samedi, dimanche et nuit)

Qui vous êtes

•
Formation continue en tant que spécialiste de la maintenance (Federal Fa) ou qualification comparable

•
De rien. 5 ans d'expérience dans l'entretien des installations de production et de logistique

•
Expérience en contact direct avec le client et forte orientation du service

• Connaissances de base et connaissances approfondies en automatisation, génie électrique, mécanique, pneumatique et hydraulique

•
Très bon allemand (minimum B2) et bon anglais (minimum B1)

•
Méthode de travail indépendante, structurée et orientée vers la solution, à haute responsabilité personnelle

•
Compréhension rapide, pensée en réseau et action proactive et innovante

•
Capacité d'équipe, communication et personnalité flexible avec un engagement élevé et une résilience physique

Qui nous sommes

Chez Belimo, nous sommes fiers de faire de notre entreprise un lieu de travail enrichissant. Nos dirigeants sont motivés par la valeur et font la promotion de nouvelles idées dans leurs équipes à travers le monde. Grâce à notre passion, nos employés non seulement créent des produits étonnants, mais révolutionnent également l'industrie du CVC. Investir dans nos employés est au cœur de Belimo quand il s'agit de mobiliser divers talents créatifs pour construire une entreprise leader de l'industrie. Le succès de notre marque est basé sur la compétence et l'engagement de chaque individu.
